gold: Type I cryoglobulinemia associated with multiple myeloma

selector.rationale: The presence of abnormal paraprotein band, monoclonal IgG-κ protein, and hypercellular marrow with atypical plasma cells supports Multiple Myeloma, while Cryoglobulinemia is also considered due to elevated serum cryoglobulin levels and cryoprotein precipitate, but Multiple Myeloma explains more decisive findings

rejected.label: Amyloidosis
rejected.why: Lack of specific amyloidosis findings, despite some overlapping features

rejected.label: Hypercalcemia of Malignancy
rejected.why: Hypercalcemia is better explained by Multiple Myeloma

rejected.label: Waldenström Macroglobulinemia
rejected.why: Less specific findings and lower score compared to Multiple Myeloma and Cryoglobulinemia
